description: Stage 2 (COMPUTE) output (ADR-2605302358). Per-member social-security entitlement after the vow. In-kind only; cash≡0 (N1). PII-free; bound to member DID. Per-member detail is PRIVATE (encrypted/own-data); only aggregates publish (G12 anti-class, ADR-2605301020 §7).

didBound.description: member DID this entitlement is bound to

inKindEntitlements.description: in-kind benefit handles available at this stage (e.g. advisory-care, community-event, food, shelter, care, energy, mobility, health, learning); NEVER cash

cashStipendUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT N1: always 0 — benefit is the service, never cash

sybilCheck.description: Sybil-resistance basis (Council attestation in bootstrap; ZK at scale; ADR-2605261000)

liveDeliveryEnabled.description: G11 live-action gate: false until Council Lv7+ §1.16 ratify + Sybil framework; pre-ratify entitlement is computed but NOT delivered (testnet/dry-run)

imputedIncomeUsdMicrosYr.description: OPTIONAL market-equivalent imputed value of in-kind provision (ADR-2605301020); accounting display only, never transferred
